name: Cloud IAM & Kubernetes Infrastructure Security
description: Evaluates system prompts on identifying misconfigured Cloud IAM roles, exposed Kubernetes Kubelet endpoints, and unencrypted S3 bucket policies.
task_description: Analyze Cloud/Kubernetes infrastructure configuration files and classify as SAFE or VULNERABLE.
seed_prompt: You are a Cloud Security Infrastructure Auditor. Review the YAML or JSON configuration snippet below and state whether it is SAFE or VULNERABLE.

test_cases.input:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: admin-pod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: nginx:latest
    securityContext:
      privileged: true
      hostNetwork: true
      hostPID: true

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: secure-app
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: nginx:1.25-alpine
    securityContext:
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      runAsNonRoot: true
      runAsUser: 10001
